description: Main application initialization and event handling for an Electron-based desktop app, including deep linking, window management, and app lifecycle events.

methods.name: initializeApplication
methods.description: Initializes the Electron app, sets up deep linking, window state, and event handlers.

methods.name: focusWindow
methods.description: Brings the app window to focus, restoring it if minimized.

methods.name: registerSingleInstanceHandler
methods.description: Handles second-instance event to focus existing window and process deep link URLs.

methods.name: registerAppEventListeners
methods.description: Sets up Electron app lifecycle event listeners such as window close, activate, open-url, and ready.

methods.name: setupDeepLinking
methods.description: Configures the app to handle custom protocol deep links.

methods.name: finishApplicationInitialization
methods.description: Completes app startup by creating main window, initializing strings, clearing cache if first run, and setting up tray icon.
